# Story 13.1: Draft the critical-review plan and document skeleton

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want a review plan for the finished codebase written into the recommendations document,
So that the per-aspect reviews in Story 13.2 have an agreed scope and order to execute against.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A review plan covering code structure, design patterns, performance, and potential areas for improvement is produced — it enumerates what to review and in what order, includes all nine aspects named in the Epic prose (Tailwind usage; readability/maintainability incl. naming conventions, code organization, clarity/terseness, best practices; style consistency; error handling & logging; security implications & vulnerabilities; test coverage & quality; dependencies & third-party libraries; documentation & comments; refactoring & optimization opportunities), and is written into the recommendations document.
2. The document skeleton `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` exists with the plan at the top followed by one clearly-marked section per aspect, each ready to be filled in by Story 13.2 — and no source file, RED/GREEN unit test, or e2e test is created or modified by this story.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1: Draft the review plan (AC: #1)
  - [ ] 1.1 Enumerate the review scope across `apps/server`, `apps/dms-material`, `apps/e2e` (`dms-material-e2e`), and `apps/electron`.
  - [ ] 1.2 Order the work: code structure → design patterns → performance → potential areas for improvement, then the nine named aspects from the Epic prose. Record this plan at the top of the document.
- [ ] Task 2: Create the document skeleton (AC: #2)
  - [ ] 2.1 Create `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` containing the review plan (Task 1) followed by one clearly-marked section per aspect, each with a short note of what to look for in that aspect — no findings yet; Story 13.2 fills them in.
  - [ ] 2.2 Confirm no source file, unit test, or e2e test was created or modified — this story produces only the document skeleton.

## Dev Notes

- **This Epic is review-only.** Per the prose: "This epic does not require the standard set of RED/GREEN Unit tests nor the e2e tests." There is no TDD triple here — two stories that together produce one recommendations document. Do NOT add or modify any source/test code; only write `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md`.
- **Output path (verbatim from prose):** `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md`. Create the directory if it does not exist. This is a planning/review artifact, separate from `.github/workflow-output/planning-artifacts/` and the story files.
- **This story stops at the skeleton.** The plan plus empty per-aspect sections only — findings belong to Story 13.2. Keep each aspect section's heading stable so Story 13.2 can fill them in place.
- **Consult the spines as reference:** ADs/FRs in `.github/workflow-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/**/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md` and `prds/**/prd.md` give intended design to compare actual code against — useful for scoping the structure/pattern/security aspects.
- **Project-specific gotchas worth checking during review (verify current state before recommending):** Electron CSP inline-script handling in packaged builds, root-hoisted deps for `dms-material`, the `no-console` hard lint rule, and the shared e2e SQLite DB reuse behavior.

### Project Structure Notes

- Add: `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` (plan + empty per-aspect sections; the only file this story creates).
- No source change, no test change — review-only by design.
- No conflict: purely additive documentation artifact outside the app trees.
